name: Dire Bat
subjectPrompt: One oversized cave bat with only two membranous wings clearly unfolding upward and outward, each wing supported by four long finger-like struts and a small thumb claw at the wrist. Broad leathery dark plum-brown membranes with sparse veins, thick gray-brown fur, large upright ears, small muzzle with a modest leaf-shaped nose, two visible hind feet and a little membrane joining the legs. Render it naturally as one cohesive flying mammal in a frontal three-quarter sweep, nose at the lower center, left wing higher than the right. Keep both wings and tips wholly in the frame. No horns, extra wings, skeletal mutations or rock.

No armor, ropes, rocks or dirt spray.
